Supreme Court to hear Bhojshala complex dispute

The Supreme Court is scheduled to hear a case concerning the Bhojshala complex. The dispute involves a demand for space near the complex for offering prayers. The matter has seen continued legal proceedings, with the next hearing set for July 29.
